vision: Every online shopper knows exactly when their parcel will arrive, and every retailer can show what each delivery cost the planet.
target-group: Customers: online retailers shipping 500 to 20,000 parcels a month in the UK and Benelux
Users: e-commerce operations managers and their support teams
Also used by: the retailers' buyers, via the tracking page
needs: Promise buyers a delivery time and keep it
Ship to the EU without customs headaches
Report carbon per order to their own big customers
product: Shipper portal and API with live tracking
30-minute ETA window sent to buyers by SMS
Measured CO2e per parcel from van telematics
Stands out: only carrier with measured, not estimated, carbon
business-goals: Grow mid-market e-commerce revenue by 25% in 2027
500 shippers on Flow Pro by December 2027
Cut support cost per parcel by 30%
